integrity: Self-review mathematical argument and finite reproducibility checks; no independent audit, external certification, or publication-priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Applies to 2-color fully occupied ordinary cycles, symmetric single-peaked utilities with 1/2<peak<1, and bilaterally strict exchanges. Characterizes existence, all stable colorings and asymptotic prevalence, not dynamical convergence, other graphs or independent priority. The six-vertex negative instance was already proved in the initiating paper.
title: High-peak Schelling rings: a unique obstruction and exponential rarity of stable placements
